name: Professor Aloysius Tick
description: Steamwright's rival inventor, jealous of his success but genuinely shocked by his death.

initial_greeting.text: Steamwright's dead? Good heavens! We were rivals, yes, but I never wished him harm. His death is a loss for all of science.

choices.text: Where were you when he died?

last_meeting.text: Two weeks ago. He was agitated, paranoid. Said he'd discovered something that would 'change everything.' I thought he was just being dramatic. Now I wonder...

alibi.text: In my laboratory, working all night. My assistant can confirm. I swear I had nothing to do with this!
